mapper.insert: INSERT INTO lost_books (copy_id, member_id, reason) VALUES (#{copyId}, #{memberId}, #{reason})
mapper.select: SELECT lost_books.*, book_copies.barcode, book_copies.book_id, books.title, members.nickname FROM lost_books JOIN book_copies ON lost_books.copy_id = book_copies.id JOIN books ON book_copies.book_id = books.id LEFT JOIN members ON lost_books.member_id = members.id ORDER BY lost_books.id DESC
